raw_definitions: Definisi : 3. process of dressing and grooming oneself, berhias diri: she spends hours on her ~, dia menghabiskan masa berjam-jam lamanya utk berhias diri. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : 2. room containing a lavatory and sometimes a wash-basin, tandas, bilik air: go to the ~, pergi ke tandas; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n 1. lavatory, tandas; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
